stem: Traffic allows a test that can detect a 15% relative lift in two weeks, so the team sets the MDE at 15%. The change pays back if it lifts conversion by 5% relative. What is wrong with how the MDE was chosen?

options.text: Nothing: the MDE should always be set by the traffic that is available
The MDE should be set after the test, equal to the lift that was observed
The MDE should be larger, at 30%, so that the test can finish sooner
It should start from the 5% that matters; the test may need to run longer
